description: Academic layout same-input pre-change and post-change evidence. Reports preserve exact engine, template, semantic corpus and asset hashes. Separate changed-template results identify purpose profiles.
baselineEngineSource: wasmppt git baseline revision tracked generated artifact; frozen independently before Rust edits.
baselineTemplates: before-templates/*.potx; copied unmodified from Cortex baseline revision public/slide-themes before theme edits.
nativeEvidence: Native debug gate: final expanded shared semantic corpus with canonical pair and body-density cases, exact source/export/font checks and seven raw samples. Different corpus from original BEFORE native evidence; totals are not a same-workload speed comparison.

nativePlannerMetrics.scope: One compiled native release process, six template-purpose combinations with seven complete planning passes each. OS maximum resident set covers all 42 passes; no SDK, composition, rendering or export. Separate from per-case JavaScript admission and sampled process memory.

nodeMatrixOsPeakMemory.execution: Separate serial Node processes on the same machine and runtime; exact engine/template/corpus/asset hashes remain in each raw report.

before.scope: Entire Node process per 480-case matrix, including startup/template preparation, all SDK replacements, all-page resolution, assets, retained report data and JSON output. OS maximum resident set, not engine-scoped heap, logical admission or sampled RSS.

after-same-input.scope: Entire Node process for the declared matrix, including startup/template preparation, all SDK replacements, all-page resolution, assets, retained report data and JSON output. OS maximum resident set, not engine-scoped heap, logical admission or sampled RSS.

after-purpose-templates.scope: Entire Node process for the declared matrix, including startup/template preparation, all SDK replacements, all-page resolution, assets, retained report data and JSON output. OS maximum resident set, not engine-scoped heap, logical admission or sampled RSS.

after-fixture.scope: Entire Node process for the declared matrix, including startup/template preparation, all SDK replacements, all-page resolution, assets, retained report data and JSON output. OS maximum resident set, not engine-scoped heap, logical admission or sampled RSS.

limitations: Saved original templates retain explicit-caption extreme-portrait shared-page failures at unchanged media/type floors. Standalone, ordinary-list and weakly related prose portrait cases recover through the full media-only bleed with zero text insets; ordinary text continues completely. Updated purpose profiles pass the full corpus.

postReviewEvidence.afterChecks: Existing font ranges/floors, measured actual-body >=72%, source presence, overlap, caption association, crop and aspect checks unchanged. Same original templates 480 cases / 15 explicit-caption findings; updated purpose templates 480 and Starter/custom 192 cases / zero findings.
postReviewEvidence.scope: Historical preceding review qualification; expandedEvidence owns the current final qualification.

sameInputNativeWork.scope: Original 53-logical-slide frozen native tuple only. Instrumented BEFORE plans match uninstrumented frozen bytes; AFTER uses reversible typed-default schema normalization. Seven deterministic passes, actual candidate/measurement events. No instrumented timing or memory claims.
